top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks to fall as oil prices near  $100; Bailey warns inflation risk ‘on upside’
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM’s FTSE 100 liveblog. The UK’s blue-chip index is set to fall on Wednesday morning, according to futures from IG. top_signals.title: DigitalBridge CEO on Investment Strategy
top_signals.summary:
Marc Ganzi, CEO of digital infrastructure investment firm DigitalBridge, discusses his views on the AI supercycle and capex spending trends among global hyperscalers and tech companies.
He speaks with Bloomberg's Stephen Engle on the sidelines of KBFG Korea Conference on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Gavekal CEO on Market Outlook, Strategy
top_signals.summary:
Louis-Vincent Gave, CEO of Gavekal, discusses his outlook for investing in global markets.
He speaks with Bloomberg's Stephen Engle on the sidelines of KBFG Korea Conference on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)
